title: Pet-Fee Refund Settlement Where Rewards Credits Paid Part of a Stay
content:
# Finance settlement note — pet-fee refund on a stay partly paid with Roamhaven Rewards credits

**Rule.** When Roamhaven Rewards credits paid part of a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category, the credit-funded part of the pet-fee refund goes back as credits and only the rest is paid to the card:

1. when credits were redeemed on the stay and none of them has been reinstated yet, the card receives the refund times one minus the credits redeemed divided by the stay's total price;
2. when credits were redeemed on the stay and part of them has already been reinstated, the card receives the refund times one minus the credits still outstanding (redeemed less reinstated) divided by the stay's total price;
3. otherwise — including when no credits were redeemed — the card receives the whole refund.

The card part is taken out before the single rounding to the cent. The credits redeemed and reinstated are the entries for the stay in the guest's Roamhaven Rewards ledger; the total price is the one recorded on the stay.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stay, total price 2,000.00, refund before the split 40.00)

| Credits on the stay | Card part |
|---|---|
| 500.00 redeemed, none reinstated | 40.00 times one minus 500.00 divided by 2,000.00 (0.75), that is 30.00 |
| 500.00 redeemed, 200.00 reinstated | outstanding 300.00; 40.00 times 0.85, that is 34.00 |
| none redeemed | 40.00 |
